attchmntText: Newspaper publication for the unaudited Standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30 , 2026
voiceSummary: Magellanic Cloud Limited published its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. GKB Ophthalmics Limited reported a net loss of 115.91 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a net loss of 164.32 lakh rupees for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Gillette India Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Public notices were issued regarding lost share certificates. Kishan Lal Poddar applied for duplicate certificates for 240 shares of Grasim Industries Limited. Nitin Narayan Wagh applied for duplicate certificates for 55 shares of Nestle India Limited. Suman Barai applied for duplicate certificates for 1205 shares of HDFC Bank Limited.

attchmntText: Approved subscription up to 2,00,00,000 (Two Crore) Compulsorily Convertible Debentures of Mcray Xtend India Private Limited, at an issue price of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) per CCD, having a face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, aggregating up to Rs. 20,00,00,000 (Twenty Crore)
voiceSummary: Magellanic Cloud Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company approved a subscription of up to 2,00,00,000 Compulsorily Convertible Debentures of Mcray Xtend India Private Limited at Rs. 10 per debenture, aggregating Rs. 20,00,00,000. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, profit after tax was Rs. 182.22 Lakhs with basic earnings per share of Rs. 0.03. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, profit after tax was Rs. 668.84 Lakhs with basic earnings per share of Rs. 0.11. The board also noted the company's participation in a rights issue of subsidiary Scandron Private Limited for Rs. 56,00,00,000, increasing its stake to 92.11 percent. The meeting was held on November 13, 2026.
